EN.검사가 양성인데|진짜일 확률은 9%?:
A positive test,
but only a 9% chance it's real?
EN.가상의 검사: 병이 있으면 꼭 양성\n없어도 10% 는 잘못 양성:
An imaginary test: always positive if you're sick,
but 10% of healthy people test positive by mistake
EN.양성이 나온 사람만 모아 보면: Let's gather everyone who tested positive
EN.양성이어도 진짜일 확률은 9% 쯤!: Even with a positive result, it's only about a 9% chance!
EN.병 없는 사람이 워낙 많아서\n10% 실수만으로도 99명이에요:
There are so many healthy people
that a 10% mistake rate alone means 99 people
EN.양성인 109명만 한 번 더 검사하면?: What if we test just those 109 again?
EN.\"양성인 사람들 중에서\" 다시 세기\n이게 조건부확률이에요:
Counting again "among the people who tested positive" —
that's conditional probability
